entries.en: Do you smell that? What’s that scent? Is that... cumin?
entries.ro: Simți mirosul ăsta? Ce aromă e? E... chimion?

entries.en: Ha, ha. Go ahead, laugh it up.
Serves you right for buying cheap hash from the Moroccans, brother.
entries.ro: Așa ți trebuie, că ai luat hașiș ieftin de la marocani, frate.

entries.en: Those boys know what they’re doing. The customs officer at the port didn’t even peek under that tarp. And their smoke is preem, trust me. Sells like fresh Moonchies.
entries.ro: Băieții ăia știu ce fac. Vameșul din port nici n-a aruncat o privire sub prelată. Și fumul lor e beton, crede-mă. Se vinde ca Moonchies proaspete.

entries.en: Fine, fine. Maybe I’ll buy some from you. Cumin, I mean. The wife loves the jeera rice I make.
entries.ro: Bine, bine. Poate cumpăr ceva de la tine. Chimion, adică. Nevastă-mea adoră orezul jeera pe care-l fac.
